label: Late-position / long-sequence detector: <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=7) and 9th original token
explanation: Fires only at late absolute positions (t>=4, almost all t>=6) and never in the copy phase. 83% of activation mass is on the <DEL> step, with firing rate rising steeply with sequence length (L=6: 18%, L=7: 55%, L>=8: 87%); the remaining mass is on the last original-phase inputs at t=7-8 (56% rate at t=8), building up across the final few original tokens toward the <DEL> peak. Magnitude grows with position/L; the top activations are length-8/9 sequences whose first token is l (first_tok l, x, d, h give a modest 1.5-2x lift), but token identity is otherwise weak and no token-set condition improved the fit. Does not fire at t<4, on short sequences (L<=5), or on any copy-phase step. Precision is limited because many long-sequence <DEL> steps stay silent, and recall misses weak <DEL> activations at L=6.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: l, x, d, q, h, w; least: b, g, t, j) and the second original token (most: l, x, w, d, h, n; least: b, g, t, j); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, L=9 & t=8, t=7.
